svg.text: Convex data flow: a project, its files, and their content
convex/schema.ts · convex/projects.ts · convex/files.ts — no UI, just tables, mutations and queries
Files and folders share one table; the tree is built from parentId → the folder's _id.
Convex reads the Clerk sign-in token sent with every request
identity.subject = the Clerk user ID, e.g. "user_3Ip…"
→ stored as projects.ownerId; every file function checks it (getOwnedProject)
→ returns the new _id (Convex adds _id and _creationTime itself)
a new project has NO rows in "files" yet
2. assertNameIsFree → same name + type in this folder? → ConvexError
inside a folder: parentId = the folder's _id
createFile { name: "page.tsx", parentId: jn71… } → row jn76… (type "file")
the tree is just parentId links: no path column
getFile({ id }) → ctx.db.get(id): the whole row INCLUDING content
getFilePath({ id }) → the file, then each parentId up to the root
getFiles({ projectId }) → index by_project: every item of the project
sent when typing pauses (1.5 s) or when switching files
1. getOwnedFileOrNull → row exists + its project is yours
2. ctx.db.patch(id, { content, updatedAt }) ← only these fields change
every query that read a changed row re-runs
files row patched → getFile pushes the new content
project row patched → project lists re-sort; "Saved … ago" updates
no refetch code anywhere: Convex tracks what each query read
